title: Console: send a same-origin `type: 'api'` action click through `POST /actions/:object/:action` instead of fetching its `target` directly (ruling on #27506, step 3 of 3)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXcN9HaZYSEUdJWEjw

立卡门：③ 维护者直派（ruling on #27506, comment 6499781492）。

## What this card is

Step 3 of the three-step ruling on #27506 (comment 6499781492). The maintainer's words, verbatim and untranslated (card thread of #27506, 2026-10-29): 「我们的平台设计目标是 agent 和人类使用同一套系统」 · 「同意」.

Blocked-by: #27506 (step 2, the server door accepting `type: 'api'` declared actions and forwarding to the declared target). Do not start before that PR is on `main`.

## Business reason

Today the console's two api handlers fetch an api action's `target` directly (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` `apiHandler`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` `apiHandler`), so the click never meets the platform's gates: switching Ban User off in Setup › Packaged automation does not stop the button (#27506), and the human click and an agent's `run_action` take different roads. After step 2 the door runs the ADR-0126 switch, ADR-0066 D4, the anonymous baseline and the audit, then forwards to the same target; the console only has to send the click there.

## Scope

- Both api handlers: for a declared `type: 'api'` action whose `target` is a same-origin platform path, POST `/api/v1/actions/:object/:action` (or `/actions/global/:action`) with `{ recordId, params }` the way the script handler (`serverActionHandler`) already does; the server assembles the target body from the declaration (`recordIdParam`, `bodyShape.wrap`, `bodyExtra`, `method`, target placeholders). Page-variable tokens (`{{page.x}}`) are client state: keep resolving them client-side and send the resolved values as `params`.
- An api action whose `target` is not same-origin keeps today's direct fetch (the server refuses to govern it; see the ruling).
- Keep the `newTabUrl` fast path (`withNewTabUrlFastPath`), the entitlement-dialog mapping of coded 403s, the `{ success, data }` unwrapping and `refreshAfter` as they are; the response shape from the door is the forwarded target's `data`.
- Pins: a switched-off api action's click answers the door's 409 `ACTION_DISABLED` and nothing is sent to the target; a switched-on click reaches the target through the door with the same body as before (compare the recorded request); an off-origin target still goes direct.

## Who acts

ui lane. Sibling #27504 (the switched-off button stays visible and its toast wording) is a separate card and stays open.
